articles.title: Why Samsung and SK Hynix shares declined heavily on Thursday?
articles.description: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares plunged on Thursday, dragging South Korea's benchmark Kospi lower as semiconductor stocks faced renewed pressure following Democratic victories in the US midterm elections. The Kospi index fell more than 5%, triggering a temporary suspension of program selling during early trading. Samsung shares dropped more than 7.5%, while SK Hynix dropped close to 9.5% as investors reassessed the outlook for AI infrastructure spending and chip demand. The two semiconductor giants together account for roughly half of the Kospi's total market capitalization, making their movements particularly influential for the broader index.
